an3.74:1.1: Again, the lack of mention of the Buddha suggests this may have been after his passing.
an3.74:1.6: The future tense with past participle is a rare example of future perfect in Pali (see also [mn81:4.3]()).
an3.74:1.7: The construction of this sentence parallels the Pali _evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti_.
